shared_elements: upright slab carved in low relief with a framed field
horizontal registers stacked one above another
a top row of three repeated rounded/arched motifs
a band of repeated linear/hatched pattern
justification: The clearest correspondence is formal rather than iconographic: both surfaces are upright slabs divided into stacked horizontal registers, each opening with a row of three repeated rounded/arched motifs, and both contain profile zoomorphic heads and a band of repeated linear marks. But A's field is wholly filled with dense, interlocking curvilinear sign-blocks (script-like cartouches with embedded faces), whereas B shows discrete, sparsely spaced figural animals \u2014 birds, a quadruped, a long-necked creature \u2014 on an open ground, so the actual subject matter and drawing conventions have almost nothing specific in common.
